newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia buys stake in Hungary's Pietra.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia buys stake in Hungary's Pietra.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia announced on Friday it had acquired a majority stake in tile maker Pietra Rt.
Zalakeramia, implementing the purchase via its Austrian subsidiary, acquired Keramia Kft, which owns 51 percent of Pietra, the company said.
The purchase price was not revealed, but the statement said that Pietra has an annual capacity of around 1.8 million square metres.
The Pietra deal follows the acquisition of a 79.3 percent stake by Zalakeramia in Croatia's Inker ceramics factory. This latter deal, made also via the Austrian subsidiary, was signed on February 28.

Zalakeramia shareholders, having already approved the plan of a capital increase of between 900 million forints and 1.2 billion forints, will vote on the details of the capital hike at a shareholders' meeting on March 19.
Zalakeramia said in January that it was planning acquisitions and was seeking to finance the purchases through a capital increase.
